claims.statement: Durga is a principal goddess in Hinduism.
claims.statement_id: Durga adalah dewi penting dalam Hinduisme.
claims.quote: This very elegant bronze figure of Devi (goddess) Durga is an attractive and prominent figure and a principal deity in Hinduism.

claims.statement: Durga means inaccessible or impassable in Sanskrit.
claims.statement_id: Nama Durga berarti tidak terjangkau atau tidak dapat dilewati dalam Sanskerta.
claims.quote: In Sanskrit, Durga means the inaccessible or impassable.

claims.statement: Durga is a warrior manifestation of Devi who defeats demons.
claims.statement_id: Durga adalah perwujudan Devi sebagai pejuang yang mengalahkan iblis.
claims.quote: Devi is most often manifested as the fearsome female warriors Durga and Kali, both of whom famously killed a number of terrible demons in Hindu mythology.

claims.statement: Durga is depicted with ten arms and weapons, riding a lion or tiger.
claims.statement_id: Durga digambarkan berlengan sepuluh, bersenjata, dan menunggangi singa atau harimau.
claims.quote: Devi's dark side is represented as the terrible Durga (the Inaccessible) who has ten arms, an impressive armoury of weapons, and who rides a magnificent lion or tiger.

claims.statement: Durga defeats Mahisha, a buffalo demon representing evil.
claims.statement_id: Durga mengalahkan Mahisha, iblis kerbau yang melambangkan kejahatan.
claims.quote: Durga slaying Mahisha (Mahishamardini) is here represented in her multi-armed form, manifesting her supreme power as the dispeller of evil, personified in the buffalo demon (asura) Mahisha, seen slumped at her feet.

claims.statement: In the Devi Mahatmya, gods lend Durga weapons to defeat the demon.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Devi Mahatmya, para dewa meminjamkan senjata kepada Durga untuk mengalahkan iblis.
claims.quote: Following the Devi Mahatmya text, she wields the mighty weapons lent to her by the assembly of male gods who singly could not defeat the demon.

claims.statement: Durga is worshipped during Navaratri in India and Nepal.
claims.statement_id: Durga dipuja dalam perayaan Navaratri di India dan Nepal.
claims.quote: Durga is also worshipped in the nine-night festival Navaratri which is celebrated across India and Nepal.

claims.statement: Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri.
claims.statement_id: Dusshera dirayakan pada akhir Navaratri.
claims.quote: The festival of Dusshera is celebrated at the end of Navaratri by Hindus wherever they live.

claims.statement: The lion is Durga's divine mount in battle imagery against Mahisha.
claims.statement_id: Singa adalah tunggangan ilahi Durga yang tampil dalam seni pertempurannya melawan Mahisha.
claims.quote: The lion, Durga’s divine mount (vahana) on which she is shown riding majestically into battle in manuscript illustrations, is here seen emerging from behind the goddess, mauling the demon-buffalo’s hind quarters.

claims.statement: One of Devi's most famous episodes is her slaying of Mahisa, a demon with a man's body and a buffalo's head, as told in the epic poem Candipat (Candi-mahatmya), part of the Skanda Purana.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu kisah paling terkenal Devi adalah pembunuhan Mahisa, iblis bertubuh manusia berkepala kerbau, seperti dikisahkan dalam puisi epik Candipat (Candi-mahatmya), bagian dari Skanda Purana.
claims.quote: One of Devi's most famous mythological escapades is her slaying of Mahisa, the demon who had the body of a man and the head of a buffalo, as told in the epic poem the Candipat (or Candi-mahatmya), which is part of the Skanda Purana.

claims.statement: In one version, the tremendous energy of the gods condensed into a single mass and formed Durga; the source notes this is only one version of her birth.
claims.statement_id: Dalam salah satu versi, energi dahsyat para dewa menyatu menjadi satu massa dan membentuk Durga; sumber menyebut ini hanya satu versi kelahirannya.
claims.quote: Swirling around heaven, this tremendous energy condensed into a single mass and formed the terrible goddess Durga. As with many Hindu tales, this is but one version of Durga's birth.

claims.statement: In other versions Devi has long existed as the daughter of Himavat, the personified deity of the Himalayas, and the angered gods only give her weapons: a discus, trident, bow, sword, dagger, harpoon, and noose.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi lain, Devi sudah lama ada sebagai putri Himavat, dewa personifikasi Himalaya, dan para dewa yang murka hanya memberinya senjata: cakram, trisula, busur, pedang, belati, tombak, dan jerat.
claims.quote: In other versions, Devi has already long existed as the daughter of Himavat, the personified deity of the Himalaya Mountains, and in this episode she is only given weapons by the angered gods. These arms include a discus, trident, bow, sword, dagger, harpoon, and a noose

claims.statement: Whenever Devi tried to deliver a fatal blow, Mahisa changed into another creature: a buffalo, a man, a lion, an elephant, and then a buffalo again.
claims.statement_id: Setiap kali Devi hendak menghantam Mahisa dengan pukulan mematikan, Mahisa berubah menjadi makhluk lain: kerbau, manusia, singa, gajah, lalu kerbau lagi.
claims.quote: The problem for Devi was that whenever she tried to strike Mahisa with a fatal blow he transformed into another creature - from a buffalo to a man to a lion, then to an elephant and back to a buffalo.

claims.statement: The goddess pounced, straddled the creature and stabbed its neck with her trident; when Mahisa's spirit came out of the dying buffalo's mouth, Durga killed him by cutting off his head.
claims.statement_id: Devi menerkam, menunggangi makhluk itu, dan menusuk lehernya dengan trisula; ketika roh Mahisa keluar dari mulut kerbau yang sekarat, Durga membunuhnya dengan memenggal kepalanya.
claims.quote: At this moment, the goddess pounced and, straddling the creature, stabbed him in the neck with her trident. At this, the spirit of Mahisa came out of the mouth of the dying buffalo and Durga finally killed him by lopping off his head.

claims.statement: Durga slaying Mahisa is a popular subject in Hindu art; one of the earliest representations is in a cave temple near Mallapuram (7th or 8th century CE) and on the Kailasanatha temple at Ellora (mid-8th century CE).
claims.statement_id: Durga membunuh Mahisa adalah subjek populer dalam seni Hindu; salah satu penggambaran paling awal ada di kuil gua dekat Mallapuram (abad ke-7 atau ke-8 M) dan di Kuil Kailasanatha di Ellora (pertengahan abad ke-8 M).
claims.quote: Durga slaying Mahisa is a popular subject in Hindu art. One of the earliest representations is in a cave temple near Mallapuram dating to the 7th or 8th century CE and on the mid-8th century CE Kailasanatha temple at Ellora.

claims.statement: Devi's character has two opposing sides: Uma, the benevolent, and Durga, the terrible; it is the fiercer side that is most frequently worshipped.
claims.statement_id: Watak Devi punya dua sisi yang berlawanan: Uma yang lembut dan Durga yang menakutkan; sisi yang lebih garang inilah yang paling sering dipuja.
claims.quote: Devi's character has two opposing sides represented by various separate female deities: as Uma, the benevolent, and as Durga, the terrible. It is as the latter, more fierce personification that she is most frequently worshipped.

claims.statement: Mahisa revealed himself and boasted of his wealth and power so that Durga would marry him; Durga responded dismissively to the proposal by transforming herself into fire.
claims.statement_id: Mahisa menyingkap dirinya dan membual tentang kekayaan serta kekuasaannya agar Durga mau menikah dengannya; Durga menanggapi lamaran itu dengan acuh dan mengubah dirinya menjadi api.
claims.quote: Mahisa then revealed himself and boasted of his tremendous wealth and power so that Durga might be persuaded to marry him. Durga's somewhat dismissive response to this proposal was to transform herself into fire.

claims.statement: Durga is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess worshipped by indigenous mountain-dwellers of the Indian subcontinent, before being established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.
claims.statement_id: Durga dipercaya berasal dari dewi kuno yang dipuja penduduk pegunungan asli anak benua India, sebelum mapan dalam panteon utama Hindu pada abad ke-4 M.
claims.quote: Durga is believed to have originated as an ancient goddess worshipped by indigenous mountain-dwellers of the Indian subcontinent, before being established in the main Hindu pantheon by the 4th century CE.

claims.statement: She is best known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the buffalo demon Mahishasura; in her battles with Shumbha and Nishumbha she manifests other warrior goddesses, the Matrikas and Kali, to aid her.
claims.statement_id: Durga paling dikenal sebagai Mahishasura-mardini karena membunuh Mahishasura, iblis kerbau; dalam pertempuran melawan Shumbha dan Nishumbha ia memunculkan dewi-dewi pejuang lain, yaitu para Matrika dan Kali, untuk membantunya.
claims.quote: She is best known as Mahishasura-mardini; for slaying Mahishasura—the buffalo demon. In accounts of her battles with other demons such as Shumbha and Nishumbha, Durga manifests other warrior goddesses, the Matrikas, and Kali, to aid in combat.

claims.statement: She is associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction and war; her legends center on combating evil and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.
claims.statement_id: Durga dikaitkan dengan perlindungan, kekuatan, keibuan, kehancuran, dan perang; kisahnya berpusat pada perlawanan terhadap kejahatan dan kekuatan iblis yang mengancam perdamaian, dharma, dan tatanan kosmis, melambangkan kemenangan kebaikan atas kejahatan.
claims.quote: She is associated with protection, strength, motherhood, destruction, and wars; her legends center around combating evils and demonic forces that threaten peace, dharma and cosmic order, representing the power of good over evil.

claims.statement: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of various male gods, given to her to fight evil because they regard her as shakti (energy, power); these include the discus, conch, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, trident, shield, mace, pink lotus and noose.
claims.statement_id: Durga secara tradisional memegang senjata berbagai dewa laki-laki yang mereka berikan agar ia melawan kejahatan karena mereka memandangnya sebagai shakti (energi, daya); di antaranya cakra, kerang, busur, anak panah, pedang, lembing, trisula, perisai, gada, bunga teratai merah muda, dan jerat.
claims.quote: Durga traditionally holds the weapons of various male gods of Hindu mythology, which they give her to fight the evil forces because they feel that she is shakti (energy, power). These include the chakra (divine discus), conch, bow, arrow, sword, javelin, trishula trident, shield, mace, pink lotus flower, and noose.

claims.statement: The word Durga literally means "impassable", "invincible, unassailable"; it is related to durg, meaning "fortress, something difficult to defeat or pass".
claims.statement_id: Kata Durga secara harfiah berarti "tak dapat dilewati", "tak terkalahkan, tak tertembus", dan berkaitan dengan kata durg yang berarti "benteng, sesuatu yang sulit dikalahkan atau dilewati".
claims.quote: The word Durga (दुर्गा) literally means "impassable", "invincible, unassailable". It is related to the word Durg (दुर्ग) which means "fortress, something difficult to defeat or pass".

claims.statement: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidra, the divine slumber, younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.
claims.statement_id: Dalam konteks Waisnawa, Durga dihormati sebagai Yoganidra, tidur ilahi, adik perempuan sekaligus versi perempuan Wisnu.
claims.quote: In Vaishnava contexts, Durga is revered as Yoganidrā, the divine slumber, younger sister and a female version of Vishnu.

claims.statement: In Vaishnava tradition, Vishnu gives Durga the task of moving Devaki's seventh child into Rohini's womb and of being born as the infant daughter of Yashoda and Nanda so she could be swapped with Krishna.
claims.statement_id: Menurut tradisi Waisnawa, Wisnu menugaskan Durga memindahkan anak ketujuh Devaki ke rahim Rohini dan lahir sebagai bayi perempuan Yashoda dan Nanda agar dapat ditukar dengan Krishna.
claims.quote: Vishnu offers Durga the task of transferring the seventh child of Devaki into the womb of Rohini, as well as being born on earth as the infant daughter of Yashoda and Nanda, so that she could be swapped with Krishna.

claims.statement: In Shaktism Durga has many epithets, and her nine appellations (Navadurga) are Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Shaktisme Durga punya banyak julukan, dan sembilan sebutannya (Navadurga) adalah Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri, dan Siddhidatri.
claims.quote: There are many epithets for Durga in Shaktism and her nine appellations are (Navadurga): Shailaputri, Brahmacharini, Chandraghanta, Kushmanda, Skandamata, Katyayini, Kalaratri, Mahagauri and Siddhidatri.

claims.statement: On the north wall of a granite cave in Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, there is a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630-674 CE.
claims.statement_id: Di dinding utara sebuah gua granit di Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu, terdapat relief besar Durga membunuh Mahisasura yang diukir sekitar 630-674 M.
claims.quote: In the north wall of a granite cave in Mamallapuram, Tamil Nadu there is a large relief of Durga slaying Mahisasura, carved around 630–674 CE.

claims.statement: Sixth-century CE inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script, such as at the Nagarjuni hill cave in the Maukhari era, already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura.
claims.statement_id: Prasasti abad ke-6 M beraksara Siddhamatrika awal, misalnya di gua bukit Nagarjuni pada masa Maukhari, sudah menyebut kisah kemenangannya atas Mahishasura.
claims.quote: The 6th-century CE inscriptions in early Siddhamatrika script, such as at the Nagarjuni hill cave during the Maukhari era, already mention the legend of her victory over Mahishasura

claims.statement: Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established when the classic text Devi Mahatmya was composed, which scholars variously date to between 400 and 600 CE.
claims.statement_id: Durga sebagai dewi pembunuh iblis kemungkinan sudah mapan ketika teks klasik Devi Mahatmya disusun, yang oleh para sarjana diperkirakan antara 400 dan 600 M.
claims.quote: Durga as a demon-slaying goddess was likely well established by the time the classic Hindu text called Devi Mahatmya was composed, which scholars variously estimate to between 400 and 600 CE.

claims.statement: Her iconography typically shows her riding a lion or a tiger, with between eight and eighteen hands, each holding a weapon.
claims.statement_id: Ikonografinya biasanya menampilkan Durga menunggangi singa atau harimau dengan delapan sampai delapan belas tangan yang masing-masing memegang senjata.
claims.quote: Her iconography typically resonates with these attributes, where she rides a lion or a tiger, has between eight and eighteen hands, each holding a weapon to destroy and create.

claims.statement: Durga iconography has been flexible in Hindu traditions; for example some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implement in her hand because they consider their stylus their weapon.
claims.statement_id: Ikonografi Durga lentur dalam tradisi Hindu; misalnya sebagian cendekiawan meletakkan pena atau alat tulis di tangannya karena menganggap penanya sebagai senjata.
claims.quote: Durga iconography has been flexible in the Hindu traditions, where for example some intellectuals place a pen or other writing implements in her hand since they consider their stylus as their weapon.

claims.statement: In this account Himavan, the personification of the Himalayas, gifted a lion as her mount.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah ini, Himavan, personifikasi Himalaya, menghadiahkan seekor singa sebagai tunggangannya.
claims.quote: Himavan, the personification of the Himalayas, gifted a lion as her mount.

claims.statement: Durga has a significant following all over Nepal, India, Bangladesh and many other countries.
claims.statement_id: Durga memiliki banyak pengikut di seluruh Nepal, India, Bangladesh, dan banyak negara lain.
claims.quote: Durga has a significant following all over Nepal, India, Bangladesh and many other countries.

claims.statement: Durga is typically portrayed as a celibate warrior goddess, but at a certain point in her history she becomes associated with the god Shiva as his wife.
claims.statement_id: Durga umumnya digambarkan sebagai dewi pejuang yang selibat, tetapi pada suatu titik dalam sejarahnya ia dikaitkan dengan Dewa Siwa sebagai istrinya.
claims.quote: Durga is typically portrayed as a celibate warrior goddess. However, at a certain point in her history, she becomes associated with the god Śiva as his wife.

claims.statement: Durga is a very popular deity; the name is applied indifferently to all goddesses with a terrible appearance and in a fighting attitude.
claims.statement_id: Durga adalah dewi yang sangat populer; nama itu dipakai tanpa pembedaan untuk semua dewi berwujud menakutkan dan bersikap bertempur.
claims.quote: Durgā is a very popular deity. The name is indifferently applied to all goddesses with a terrible appearance and in a fighting attitude.

claims.statement: The Saivagama specifically describes nine varieties of Durga, all with two arms but different weapons.
claims.statement_id: Saivagama secara khusus menguraikan sembilan ragam Durga, semuanya bertangan dua tetapi bersenjata berbeda.
claims.quote: The Saivāgama specifically describes nine varieties of Durgā, all of which have two arms but different weapons

claims.statement: In this role as Shiva's wife, Durga assumes domestic characteristics and is often identified with the goddess Parvati.
claims.statement_id: Dalam peran sebagai istri Siwa, Durga mengambil sifat rumah tangga dan sering diidentifikasi dengan dewi Parwati.
claims.quote: In this role, Durgā assumes domestic characteristics and is often identified with the goddess Parvati.

claims.statement: The general description of Durga in the Kasyapa-Silpa shows her with four arms and two eyes.
claims.statement_id: Uraian umum tentang Durga dalam Kasyapa-Silpa menggambarkannya berlengan empat dan bermata dua.
claims.quote: The general description of Durgā given in the Kāsyapa-Silpa represents her as having four arms, two eyes

claims.statement: A figure of Durga from Mahabalipuram stands on the buffalo's head and has eight arms; the discus and the conch are in the uppermost ones.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah arca Durga dari Mahabalipuram berdiri di atas kepala kerbau dan berlengan delapan; di tangan teratasnya terdapat cakram dan kerang.
claims.quote: From Mahābalipuram comes the figure of a Durgā (fig. 124) who stands on the buffalo's head. She has eight arms, in the uppermost of which are found the discus and the conch.

claims.statement: Durga is commonly known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the half-buffalo demon Mahishasura, and also as Vindhyavasini (she who dwells in the Vindhya Mountains).
claims.statement_id: Durga lazim disebut Mahishasura-mardini karena membunuh iblis setengah kerbau Mahishasura, dan juga dikenal sebagai Vindhyavasini (ia yang tinggal di Pegunungan Vindhya).
claims.quote: Durga is commonly known as Mahishasura-mardini for slaying the half-buffalo demon Mahishasura. She is also known as Vindhyavasini (she who dwells in the Vindhya Mountains).

claims.statement: Durga is also known as Durgati Nashini, meaning one who eliminates suffering.
claims.statement_id: Durga juga dikenal sebagai Durgati Nashini, yang berarti ia yang melenyapkan penderitaan.
claims.quote: Durga is also known as Durgati Nashini, meaning one who eliminates suffering.

claims.statement: Mahisa managed to drive most of the gods out of heaven, forcing them to wander the earth as mere men.
claims.statement_id: Mahisa berhasil mengusir sebagian besar dewa dari surga sehingga mereka berkelana di bumi sebagai manusia biasa.
claims.quote: Doing rather well, Mahisa managed to kick most of the gods out of heaven, forcing them to wander the earth as mere men.

claims.statement: Juno is a Roman goddess who protected the nation and women's lives.
claims.statement_id: Juno adalah dewi Romawi pelindung negara dan kehidupan perempuan.
claims.quote: Juno was the Roman goddess who protected the nation as a whole but also kept special watch over all aspects of women's lives.

claims.statement: Juno is often equated with the Greek goddess Hera.
claims.statement_id: Juno kerap dipadankan dengan Hera dari Yunani.
claims.quote: She is often thought of as the Roman version of the Greek goddess of love and marriage, Hera.

claims.statement: Juno was Jupiter's wife and sister and was worshipped with Minerva.
claims.statement_id: Juno adalah istri sekaligus saudari Jupiter dan dipuja bersama Minerva.
claims.quote: Juno was the wife and sister of Jupiter, the chief Roman god, and the two of them were worshipped along with the goddess Minerva on the Quirinal in Rome.

claims.statement: Ancient authors associate Juno Regina with Veii; Regina means queen.
claims.statement_id: Sumber kuno mengaitkan Juno Regina dengan Veii; Regina berarti ratu.
claims.quote: Some ancient authors claim Juno arrived in Rome in the fifth century BCE from the Etruscan town of Veii north of Rome as Juno Regina, a word meaning queen.

claims.statement: As Juno Lucina she was a goddess of childbirth.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai Juno Lucina, ia adalah dewi kelahiran.
claims.quote: She was Juno Lucina, a word meaning light, the goddess of childbirth.

claims.statement: Juno protected legally married women.
claims.statement_id: Juno melindungi perempuan yang telah menikah secara sah.
claims.quote: She was the protector of legally married women.

claims.statement: Juno's Matronalia festival fell on March 1.
claims.statement_id: Matronalia, perayaan Juno, jatuh pada 1 Maret.
claims.quote: Like many gods or goddesses, she had her own festival, on March 1, called the Matronalia, which was a time of renewal and the awakening of nature.

claims.statement: A peacock identifies Juno in art.
claims.statement_id: Merak menjadi penanda Juno dalam karya seni.
claims.quote: The presence of the peacock identifies the figure as Juno, Jupiter’s wife and the goddess of marriage

claims.statement: In Aeneas's story, Juno loved Carthage, which was prophesied to be destroyed by Rome.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Aeneas, Juno mencintai Carthage yang diramalkan akan dihancurkan Roma.
claims.quote: Juno loved the city of Carthage and, according to prophecy, her beloved city would one day be destroyed by Rome, a city to be founded by Aeneas.

claims.statement: As Juno Sospita she was the chief deity of Lanuvium, a city in Latium southeast of Rome; she protected those in confinement and was often pictured wearing a goatskin and carrying a spear and shield.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai Juno Sospita, ia dewa utama Lanuvium, kota di Latium tenggara Roma; ia pelindung orang yang terkurung dan sering digambarkan mengenakan kulit kambing serta membawa tombak dan perisai.
claims.quote: Among other identities, she was known to many as Juno Sospita, the chief deity of Lanuvium, a city located in Latium southeast of Rome. She was the protector of one in confinement, often pictured wearing a goatskin, carrying a spear and shield.

claims.statement: As Juno Moneta she is called the moon goddess, a personage unique to Rome.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai Juno Moneta, ia disebut dewi bulan, tokoh yang khas Roma.
claims.quote: Lastly, she was Juno Moneta, the moon goddess, who was a personage unique to Rome.

claims.statement: Her primary temple was built on the Arx, the northern part of Capitoline Hill, next to the Roman mint; the word "money" comes from her name, Moneta.
claims.statement_id: Kuil utamanya dibangun di Arx, bagian utara Bukit Capitoline, di samping percetakan uang Roma; kata "money" berasal dari namanya, Moneta.
claims.quote: her primary temple or citadel was built on the Arx, the northern part of Capitoline Hill. This sanctuary was located next to the Roman mint; the word money comes from her name, Moneta.

claims.statement: Her sacred geese were kept on the Capitoline, and legend says they warned the Roman military under Manlius Capitolinus when the invading Gauls tried to take Rome in 390 BCE.
claims.statement_id: Angsa-angsa sucinya dipelihara di Capitoline; menurut legenda, angsa itu memperingatkan pasukan Romawi di bawah Manlius Capitolinus ketika bangsa Galia menyerbu Roma pada 390 SM.
claims.quote: Her sacred geese were kept on the Capitoline and a legend is told that they gave warning to the Roman military under the leadership of Manlius Capitolinus when the invading Gauls tried to take Rome in 390 BCE.

claims.statement: At her temple no offering could be made unless all knots were untied, because a belt could hinder the delivery of the woman's child.
claims.statement_id: Di kuil Juno Lucina tidak boleh ada persembahan kecuali semua simpul dilepas, karena sabuk dapat menghambat kelahiran anak.
claims.quote: No offering could be made at her temple unless all knots were untied because the presence of a belt could hinder the delivery of the woman's child.

claims.statement: On the Matronalia husbands were expected to give presents to their wives; the day was supposedly celebrating the birthday of her son Mars, the god of war.
claims.statement_id: Pada hari Matronalia suami diharapkan memberi hadiah kepada istri; hari itu konon merayakan ulang tahun putranya, Mars, dewa perang.
claims.quote: It was a day when husbands were expected to give presents to their wives. The day was supposedly in celebration of the birthday of her son Mars, the god of war.

claims.statement: According to legend Juno was connected with the city of Carthage, where she was identified with the goddess Tanit.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, Juno punya hubungan dengan kota Carthage, tempat ia diidentifikasi dengan dewi Tanit.
claims.quote: According to legend, there was a connection between Juno and the city of Carthage where she was identified with the goddess Tanit.

claims.statement: In the Aeneas story a storm at sea created by Juno failed when Neptune interfered, not out of love for Aeneas but out of irritation at Juno meddling in his domain.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Aeneas, badai di laut yang diciptakan Juno gagal ketika Neptunus ikut campur, bukan karena sayang kepada Aeneas melainkan karena kesal pada campur tangan Juno di wilayahnya.
claims.quote: Next, a storm at sea, created by Juno, failed when Neptune interfered, not for the love of Aeneas, but owing to his irritation at Juno's interference in his domain.

claims.statement: Her exact origin is unknown, but Juno was one of the oldest Roman deities, one of the three original gods (Jupiter, Juno, Minerva) honored on the Quirinal and later on the Capitoline.
claims.statement_id: Asal-usulnya tidak diketahui pasti, tetapi Juno termasuk dewa Romawi tertua, salah satu dari tiga dewa awal (Jupiter, Juno, Minerva) yang dihormati di Quirinal, kemudian di Capitoline.
claims.quote: Although her exact origin is unknown, Juno was one of the oldest of the Roman deities, that is, one of the three original gods — Jupiter, Juno, and Minerva — honored on the Quirinal (later on the Capitoline).

claims.statement: Under whatever name she was known, Juno presided over every aspect of a woman's life.
claims.statement_id: Dengan nama apa pun ia dikenal, Juno menaungi setiap segi kehidupan perempuan.
claims.quote: By whatever name she was known, Juno presided over every aspect of a woman's life.

claims.statement: Juno was the chief Roman and Latin goddess and the special object of worship by women at all the critical moments of life.
claims.statement_id: Juno adalah dewi utama Romawi dan Latin, dan objek pemujaan khusus perempuan pada semua saat penting dalam hidup.
claims.quote: JUNO, the chief Roman and Latin goddess, and the special object of worship by women at all the critical moments of life.

claims.statement: Juno was especially a deity of women and in a sense represents the female principle of life, as shown by the fact that every man had his genius and every woman her Juno.
claims.statement_id: Juno terutama dewi perempuan dan dalam arti tertentu mewakili prinsip kehidupan perempuan, terlihat dari kenyataan bahwa setiap laki-laki punya genius-nya dan setiap perempuan punya Juno-nya.
claims.quote: That Juno was especially a deity of women, and represents in a sense the female principle of life, is seen in the fact that as every man had his genius, so every woman had her Juno

claims.statement: As Caprotina she was worshipped especially by female slaves on 7 July (Nonae Caprotinae); as Sospita she was invoked all over Latium as the saviour of women in peril and later of the state.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai Caprotina ia dipuja terutama oleh budak perempuan pada 7 Juli (Nonae Caprotinae); sebagai Sospita ia dipanggil di seluruh Latium sebagai penyelamat perempuan dalam bahaya, dan kemudian sebagai penyelamat negara.
claims.quote: As Caprotina she was especially worshipped by female slaves on the 7th of July (Nonae Caprotinae); as Sospita she was invoked all over Latium as the saviour of women in their perils, and later as the saviour of the state

claims.statement: In historical times she was associated with Jupiter in the great temple on the Capitoline hill as Juno Regina, queen of all the Junones or queen of heaven.
claims.statement_id: Pada masa sejarah ia dipuja bersama Jupiter di kuil besar di Bukit Capitoline sebagai Juno Regina, ratu semua Junones atau ratu langit.
claims.quote: But in historical times she was associated with Jupiter in the great temple on the Capitoline hill as Juno Regina, the queen of all Junones or queen of heaven

claims.statement: The etymology of the name is uncertain, but it is usually taken as a shortened form of Jovino, answering to Jovis, from a root div meaning shining.
claims.statement_id: Asal kata namanya tidak pasti, tetapi biasanya dianggap bentuk singkat dari Jovino, padanan Jovis, dari akar div yang berarti bersinar.
claims.quote: The etymology of the name is not certain, but it is usually taken as a shortened form of Jovino, answering to Jovis, from a root div, shining.

claims.statement: According to this source it was again under Greek influence that she became Jupiter's wife and Mars's mother; the true Roman had no such personal interest in his deities as to invent family relations for them.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sumber ini, pengaruh Yunani juga yang menjadikannya istri Jupiter dan ibu Mars; orang Romawi sejati tidak berminat mengarang hubungan keluarga bagi dewa-dewanya.
claims.quote: It was under Greek influence again that she became the wife of Jupiter, the mother of Mars; the true Roman had no such personal interest in his deities as to invent family relations for them.

claims.statement: Under Greek influence Juno was early identified with Hera, with whom she shares much cult and character; thus the Juno familiar from Latin literature is not the true Roman deity.
claims.statement_id: Karena pengaruh Yunani, Juno sejak dini diidentifikasi dengan Hera yang banyak kesamaan kultus dan wataknya; maka Juno dalam sastra Latin bukanlah dewi Romawi yang sejati.
claims.quote: Under Greek influence Juno was early identified with the Greek Hera, with whose cult and characteristics she has much in common; thus the Juno with whom we are familiar in Latin literature is not the true Roman deity.

claims.statement: Juno is the daughter of Saturn and Ops, sister and wife of Jupiter, and mother of Mars, Vulcan, Bellona, Lucina and Juventas; like Hera her sacred animal is the peafowl, and her Etruscan counterpart is Uni.
claims.statement_id: Juno putri Saturnus dan Ops, saudari sekaligus istri Jupiter, serta ibu Mars, Vulcanus, Bellona, Lucina, dan Juventas; seperti Hera, hewan sucinya adalah merak, dan padanannya dalam tradisi Etruria adalah Uni.
claims.quote: A daughter of Saturn and Ops, she is the sister and wife of Jupiter and the mother of Mars, Vulcan, Bellona, Lucina and Juventas. Like Hera, her sacred animal is the peafowl. Her Etruscan counterpart is Uni, and she was said to also watch over the women of Rome.

claims.statement: Her warlike aspect among the Romans is apparent in her attire; she was often shown armed and wearing a goatskin cloak.
claims.statement_id: Sisi perangnya di kalangan Romawi tampak pada pakaiannya; ia sering digambarkan bersenjata dan mengenakan jubah kulit kambing.
claims.quote: Juno's own warlike aspect among the Romans is apparent in her attire. She was often shown armed and wearing a goatskin cloak.

claims.statement: As patron goddess of Rome and the Roman Empire Juno was called Regina ("Queen") and belongs to the Capitoline Triad (Juno Capitolina) with Jupiter and Minerva, goddess of wisdom.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai dewi pelindung Roma dan Kekaisaran Romawi, Juno disebut Regina ("Ratu") dan menjadi anggota Triad Capitoline (Juno Capitolina) bersama Jupiter dan Minerva, dewi kebijaksanaan.
claims.quote: As the patron goddess of Rome and the Roman Empire, Juno was called Regina ("Queen") and is a member of the Capitoline Triad (Juno Capitolina), centered on the Capitoline Hill in Rome, which also includes Jupiter and Minerva, goddess of wisdom.

claims.statement: The view that she was also a moon goddess is no longer accepted by scholars, as that role belongs to Diana Lucifera.
claims.statement_id: Pandangan bahwa ia juga dewi bulan tidak lagi diterima para sarjana, karena peran itu milik Diana Lucifera.
claims.quote: The view that she was also a Moon goddess though is no longer accepted by scholars, as such a role belongs to Diana Lucifera

claims.statement: A derivation was later proposed from iuven- (as in iuvenis, "youth") through a syncopated form iūn-.
claims.statement_id: Diusulkan pula turunan dari iuven- (seperti iuvenis, "pemuda") lewat bentuk iūn-.
claims.quote: a derivation was later proposed from iuven- (as in Latin iuvenis, "youth"), through a syncopated form iūn- (as in iūnix, "heifer", and iūnior, "younger").

claims.statement: Juno is certainly the divine protectress of the community, showing both a sovereign and a fertility character, often associated with a military one.
claims.statement_id: Juno jelas pelindung ilahi komunitas yang memperlihatkan watak berdaulat dan kesuburan, sering dikaitkan dengan watak militer.
claims.quote: Juno is certainly the divine protectress of the community, who shows both a sovereign and a fertility character, often associated with a military one.

claims.statement: The epithet Lucina reflects two interrelated aspects of Juno's function: the cyclical renewal of time in the waning and waxing moon, and protection of delivery and birth.
claims.statement_id: Julukan Lucina mencerminkan dua segi fungsi Juno: pembaruan waktu yang berputar menurut bulan surut dan purnama, serta perlindungan persalinan dan kelahiran.
claims.quote: The epithet Lucina is particularly revealing since it reflects two interrelated aspects of the function of Juno: cyclical renewal of time in the waning and waxing of the moon and protection of delivery and birth

claims.statement: Juno is closely associated with Janus, the god of passages and beginnings, who is often named Iunonius after her.
claims.statement_id: Juno berkaitan erat dengan Janus, dewa gerbang dan permulaan, yang sering disebut Iunonius menurut namanya.
claims.quote: She is closely associated with Janus, the god of passages and beginnings, who is often named Iunonius after her.

claims.statement: According to Virgil, there was little love between Aeneas, the Trojan hero of the story, and the goddess.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Vergilius, hanya ada sedikit kasih antara Aeneas, pahlawan Troya dalam kisah itu, dan sang dewi.
claims.quote: According to Virgil, there was little love between Aeneas, the story's Trojan hero, and the Roman goddess.

claims.statement: Virgil used Juno as the story's antagonist, although the name of Hera could just as easily be substituted.
claims.statement_id: Vergilius menjadikan Juno antagonis kisah itu, meski nama Hera bisa dengan mudah menggantikannya.
claims.quote: Although Virgil used Juno as the story's antagonist (he was, of course, Roman), the name of Hera could just as easily be substituted.

claims.statement: She received a temple on the Aventine Hill and served as a civic deity, the protector of the state.
claims.statement_id: Ia mendapat kuil di Bukit Aventine dan berperan sebagai dewi kota, pelindung negara.
claims.quote: She received a temple on the Aventine Hill and served as a civic deity, the protector of the state.

claims.statement: On 1 March, the old Roman New Year's day, the matrons met and made offerings at her temple in a grove on the Esquiline, hence the name Matronalia.
claims.statement_id: Pada 1 Maret, hari tahun baru Romawi lama, para matron berkumpul dan mempersembahkan sesaji di kuilnya di sebuah hutan kecil di Esquiline; karena itu hari itu disebut Matronalia.
claims.quote: on the 1st of March, the old Roman New Year's day, the matrons met and made offerings at her temple in a grove on the Esquiline; hence the day was known as the Matronalia.

claims.statement: Some authors claim the festival actually celebrated the anniversary of the end of the Roman-Sabine War and honored the role women played.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian penulis menyatakan festival itu sebenarnya merayakan berakhirnya Perang Romawi-Sabin dan menghormati peran perempuan.
claims.quote: Some authors claim the festival actually celebrated the anniversary of the end of the Roman-Sabine War and honored the role women played.

claims.statement: Juno was the wife and sister of Jupiter, and the two were worshipped along with Minerva on the Quirinal in Rome.
claims.statement_id: Juno adalah istri dan saudari Jupiter; keduanya dipuja bersama Minerva di Quirinal, Roma.
claims.quote: Juno was the wife and sister of Jupiter, the chief Roman god, and the two of them were worshipped along with the goddess Minerva on the Quirinal in Rome.

claims.statement: Under the same title she was enticed from Veii after its capture in 392 B.C. and settled in a temple on the Aventine.
claims.statement_id: Dengan gelar yang sama ia dibujuk keluar dari Veii setelah kota itu direbut pada 392 SM dan ditempatkan di sebuah kuil di Aventine.
claims.quote: and under the same title she was enticed from Veii after its capture in 392 B.C., and settled in a temple on the Aventine.

claims.statement: Mercury is the Roman god of commerce and mediator between gods and mortals.
claims.statement_id: Mercury adalah dewa perdagangan Romawi dan perantara dewa dengan manusia.
claims.quote: Mercury (Mercurius) was the Roman god of commerce, often serving as a mediator between the gods and mortals

claims.statement: Mercury protected merchants and travelers.
claims.statement_id: Mercury melindungi pedagang dan pelancong.
claims.quote: Mercury protected both merchants, especially those dealing in grains, and travelers.

claims.statement: Mercury was said to be the son of Jupiter and Maia.
claims.statement_id: Mercury disebut putra Jupiter dan Maia.
claims.quote: Mercury was the son of the king of the gods Jupiter and purportedly Maia, goddess of the plains.

claims.statement: Mercury is associated with Hermes; Mercurius may derive from merx.
claims.statement_id: Mercury dipadankan dengan Hermes; nama Mercurius mungkin berasal dari merx.
claims.quote: he is often associated with his Greek counterpart Hermes. His Roman name Mercurius is probably derived from the Latin word for merchandise (merx).

claims.statement: Mercury escorted the dead to the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Mercury mengantar arwah ke dunia bawah.
claims.quote: Like Hermes, he escorted the dead to the underworld.

claims.statement: Mercury is depicted with a caduceus and winged sandals.
claims.statement_id: Mercury digambarkan membawa caduceus dan mengenakan sandal bersayap.
claims.quote: The god is frequently depicted holding the caduceus, a wand used to reconcile conflicts, and winged sandals for quickly carrying messages for the gods.

claims.statement: Mercury's festival day was May 15.
claims.statement_id: Hari raya Mercury diperingati pada 15 Mei.
claims.quote: Mercury's festival day was celebrated on May 15 in commemoration of the founding of his temple.

claims.statement: Mercury reminded Aeneas to leave Dido and Carthage.
claims.statement_id: Mercury mengingatkan Aeneas untuk meninggalkan Dido dan Carthage.
claims.quote: It was Mercury who was sent to remind the Trojan Aeneas to leave his beloved Queen Dido and Carthage and achieve his destiny to found Rome.

claims.statement: Roman statuettes show Mercury holding a staff and purse.
claims.statement_id: Patung Romawi menggambarkan Mercury dengan tongkat dan pundi-pundi.
claims.quote: Roman statuettes of bronze, in which Mercury is represented, like the Greek Hermes, standing holding the caduceus or staff in the one hand and a purse in the other

claims.statement: Allegedly, while escorting the nymph Lara to Pluto's realm, he fathered the twin Lares, guardian gods of Rome.
claims.statement_id: Konon, ketika mengantar nimfa Lara ke dunia Pluto, ia menjadi ayah si kembar Lares, dewa penjaga Roma.
claims.quote: Allegedly, while escorting the nymph Lara to Pluto's realm, he fathered the twin Lares, guardian gods of Rome.

claims.statement: A temple honoring him was built around 495 BCE on the southwest slope of the Aventine Hill near the Circus Maximus of Rome.
claims.statement_id: Kuil untuknya dibangun sekitar 495 SM dan berdiri di lereng barat daya Bukit Aventine dekat Circus Maximus, Roma.
claims.quote: A temple honoring him was built around 495 BCE and stood on the southwest slope of Aventine Hill near the Circus Maximus of Rome.

claims.statement: A cult honoring him existed outside the city of Rome in Campania and Latium, as well as in Gaul and Britain.
claims.statement_id: Kultus untuknya ada di luar kota Roma, di Campania dan Latium, serta di Galia dan Britania.
claims.quote: A cult paying homage to him existed outside the city of Rome in Campania and Latium as well as in Gaul and Britain.

claims.statement: Besides the wand and sandals, he wore a broad-brimmed hat, the Petasus, and carried a purse, a symbol of his duties as god of commerce and profits.
claims.statement_id: Selain tongkat dan sandal, ia mengenakan topi lebar bernama Petasus dan membawa pundi-pundi, lambang tugasnya sebagai dewa perdagangan dan keuntungan.
claims.quote: Besides the wand and sandals, he also wore a broad-brimmed hat, the Petasus, and carried a purse, a symbol of his duties as the god of commerce and profits.

claims.statement: To many he was also known as cunning and shrewd as well as a deceiver, often pulling pranks on the unsuspecting, especially the god Apollo.
claims.statement_id: Bagi banyak orang ia juga dikenal licik dan cerdik sekaligus penipu yang sering mengerjai orang yang lengah, terutama dewa Apollo.
claims.quote: However, to many, he was also known for being cunning and shrewd as well as a deceiver, often pulling pranks on the unsuspecting, especially the god Apollo.

claims.statement: Besides being the god of commerce, Mercury was patron of shepherds, cheats and thieves; Ovid relays a story of Mercury as a master thief himself.
claims.statement_id: Selain dewa perdagangan, Mercury juga pelindung gembala, penipu, dan pencuri; Ovidius menuturkan kisah Mercury sebagai pencuri ulung.
claims.quote: Besides the god of commerce, Mercury was also the patron of shepherds, cheats and thieves. Ovid relays a story of Mercury who was a master thief himself.

claims.statement: In Ovid's story of Battus, after being promised a heifer and a bull, the old man revealed everything; an angry Mercury turned him into stone.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Ovidius tentang Battus, setelah dijanjikan seekor sapi dara dan seekor banteng, lelaki tua itu membocorkan semuanya; Mercury yang marah mengubahnya menjadi batu.
claims.quote: After being promised a heifer and a bull if he talked, the old man revealed all. Angry, Mercury turned him into stone.

claims.statement: To free Io, Mercury told Argus boring stories until he fell asleep; after Mercury beheaded Argus, Io was freed.
claims.statement_id: Untuk membebaskan Io, Mercury menceritakan kisah-kisah membosankan kepada Argus sampai ia tertidur; setelah Mercury memenggal Argus, Io bebas.
claims.quote: In order to free Io Mercury told Argus boring stories until he finally fell asleep. After Mercury beheaded Argus, Io was freed.

claims.statement: In Roman mythology it is Mercury who escorts the young Proserpina, daughter of Ceres, to the underworld to be with Pluto (the Greek Hades).
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Romawi, Mercury yang mengantar Proserpina muda, putri Ceres, ke dunia bawah untuk bersama Pluto (Hades dalam tradisi Yunani).
claims.quote: In Roman Mythology it is Mercury who escorts the young Proserpina, daughter of Ceres, to the underworld to be with Pluto (the Greek Hades).

claims.statement: One story shows Mercury as a small child, though it is more often attributed to Hermes: he built a lyre from a tortoiseshell, then one night slipped away from his mother and stole Apollo's oxen.
claims.statement_id: Satu kisah menampilkan Mercury kecil, meski lebih sering dikaitkan dengan Hermes: ia membuat kecapi dari cangkang kura-kura, lalu pada suatu malam menyelinap dari ibunya dan mencuri sapi-sapi Apollo.
claims.quote: One last story tells of the adventuresome Mercury as a small child - again it is an episode more often attributed to Hermes. Although a talented child - he built a lyre out of a tortoiseshell - one night he slipped away from his mother and, spying Apollo's oxen grazing in a field, stole them.

claims.statement: In Greek mythology the wand had been given to him by Apollo.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Yunani, tongkat itu diberikan kepadanya oleh Apollo.
claims.quote: The wand had been given to him by Apollo in Greek mythology.

claims.statement: As with many Roman myths, narratives about Mercury became intertwined with those of Hermes, so it is often difficult to separate the two.
claims.statement_id: Seperti banyak kisah mitologi Romawi, kisah Mercury menjadi bercampur dengan kisah Hermes sehingga sulit dipisahkan.
claims.quote: As with many stories in Roman mythology, narratives about Mercury became intertwined with those of Hermes, so it is often difficult to separate the two.

claims.statement: Merchants would pray to him for high profits and protection of their trade goods.
claims.statement_id: Para pedagang berdoa kepadanya untuk memohon keuntungan besar dan perlindungan barang dagangan.
claims.quote: Merchants would pray to him for high profits and protection of their trade goods.

claims.statement: In 495 the Greek god Hermes was introduced into Rome under the Italian name Mercurius, as protector of the grain trade, especially with Sicily.
claims.statement_id: Pada 495 SM dewa Yunani Hermes diperkenalkan ke Roma dengan nama Italia Mercurius, sebagai pelindung perdagangan gandum, terutama dengan Sisilia.
claims.quote: in 495 the Greek god Hermes was introduced into Rome under the Italian name of Mercurius (Livy ii. 21, 27), as protector of the grain trade, especially with Sicily.

claims.statement: On the 15th of May every shopman drew water from this spring and sprinkled it with a laurel twig over his head and goods, entreating Mercury to remove the guilt of all his deceits.
claims.statement_id: Pada 15 Mei setiap pemilik toko mengambil air dari mata air itu dan memercikkannya dengan ranting salam ke kepala dan barangnya sambil memohon Mercury menghapus kesalahan semua tipuannya.
claims.quote: every shopman drew water from this spring on the 15th of May, and sprinkled it with a laurel twig over his head and over his goods, at the same time entreating Mercury to remove from his head and his goods the guilt of all his deceits

claims.statement: The word mercurialis was popularly used as equivalent to "cheat".
claims.statement_id: Kata mercurialis dipakai secara populer sebagai padanan "penipu".
claims.quote: The word mercurialis was popularly used as equivalent to “cheat.”

claims.statement: The 15th of May was chosen as Mercury's feast because Maia was the mother of Hermes, that is, of Mercury; on this day she was worshipped with her son by the mercuriales.
claims.statement_id: Tanggal 15 Mei dipilih sebagai pesta Mercury karena Maia ibu Hermes, yaitu Mercury; pada hari itu ia dipuja bersama putranya oleh para mercuriales.
claims.quote: The 15th of May was chosen as the feast of Mercury, obviously because Maia was the mother of Hermes, that is of Mercury; and she was worshipped along with her son by the mercuriales on this day.

claims.statement: Mercury (Mercurius), in Roman mythology, was the god of merchandise (merx) and merchants, later identified with the Greek Hermes.
claims.statement_id: Mercury (Mercurius) dalam mitologi Romawi adalah dewa barang dagangan (merx) dan pedagang, yang kemudian diidentifikasi dengan Hermes dari Yunani.
claims.quote: MERCURY (Mercurius), in Roman mythology, the god of merchandise (merx) and merchants; later identified with the Greek Hermes.

claims.statement: He is the god of boundaries, commerce, communication (including divination), eloquence, financial gain, languages, luck, thieves, travelers and trickery, and the guide of souls to the underworld.
claims.statement_id: Ia dewa batas, perdagangan, komunikasi (termasuk ramalan), kefasihan, keuntungan finansial, bahasa, keberuntungan, pencuri, pelancong, dan tipu daya, serta pemandu jiwa ke dunia bawah.
claims.quote: He is the god of boundaries, commerce, communication (including divination), eloquence, financial gain, languages, luck, thieves, travelers, and trickery; he is also the guide of souls to the underworld.

claims.statement: In Roman mythology he was the son of Maia, daughter of the Titan Atlas, and Jupiter; in his earliest forms he appears related to the Etruscan deity Turms.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Romawi ia putra Maia, putri Titan Atlas, dan Jupiter; dalam bentuk paling awalnya ia tampaknya berkerabat dengan dewa Etruria Turms.
claims.quote: In Roman mythology, he was the son of Maia, daughter of the Titan Atlas, and Jupiter. In his earliest forms, he appears to have been related to the Etruscan deity Turms

claims.statement: He was often accompanied by a rooster, herald of the new day, a ram or goat symbolizing fertility, and a tortoise referring to his legendary invention of the lyre from a tortoise shell.
claims.statement_id: Ia sering ditemani ayam jantan, pewarta hari baru, domba jantan atau kambing, lambang kesuburan, dan kura-kura yang merujuk pada penemuan kecapi dari cangkangnya.
claims.quote: He was often accompanied by a rooster, herald of the new day, a ram or goat, symbolizing fertility, and a tortoise, referring to Mercury's legendary invention of the lyre from a tortoise shell.

claims.statement: Mercury was not among the di indigetes of early Roman religion; he subsumed the earlier Dei Lucrii as Roman religion was syncretized with Greek religion under the Republic, starting around the 4th century BC.
claims.statement_id: Mercury tidak termasuk di indigetes awal agama Romawi; ia menyerap Dei Lucrii yang lebih tua ketika agama Romawi disinkretiskan dengan agama Yunani pada masa Republik, mulai sekitar abad ke-4 SM.
claims.quote: Mercury did not appear among the numinous di indigetes of early Roman religion. Rather, he subsumed the earlier Dei Lucrii as Roman religion was syncretized with Greek religion during the time of the Roman Republic, starting around the 4th century BC.

claims.statement: Julius Caesar wrote that Mercury was the most popular god in Britain and Gaul, regarded as inventor of all the arts; in Roman syncretism he was equated with the Celtic god Lugus and commonly accompanied by the goddess Rosmerta.
claims.statement_id: Julius Caesar menulis bahwa Mercury adalah dewa terpopuler di Britania dan Galia, dipandang sebagai penemu segala seni; dalam sinkretisme Romawi ia disamakan dengan dewa Kelt Lugus dan biasanya ditemani dewi Rosmerta.
claims.quote: Julius Caesar wrote of Mercury being the most popular god in Britain and Gaul, regarded as the inventor of all the arts. This is probably because, in the Roman syncretism, Mercury was equated with the Celtic god Lugus, and in this aspect was commonly accompanied by the Celtic goddess Rosmerta.

claims.statement: The Romans associated Mercury with the Germanic god Wotan; Tacitus identifies him as the chief god of the Germanic peoples, and the link is seen in the day-names Wednesday and Mercredi.
claims.statement_id: Orang Romawi menghubungkan Mercury dengan dewa Jermanik Wotan; Tacitus menyebutnya dewa utama bangsa Jermanik, dan kaitan itu terlihat pada nama hari Wednesday dan Mercredi.
claims.quote: Romans associated Mercury with the Germanic god Wotan ... 1st-century Roman writer Tacitus identifies him as the chief god of the Germanic peoples. This association of Mercury and Wotan is seen in the English language day-name Wednesday and the French Mercredi.

claims.statement: There was a spring dedicated to Mercury between his temple and the Porta Capena; every shopman drew water from it on the 15th of May.
claims.statement_id: Ada mata air yang dipersembahkan kepada Mercury di antara kuilnya dan Porta Capena; pada 15 Mei setiap pemilik toko menimba air dari mata air itu.
claims.quote: There was a spring dedicated to Mercury between his temple and the Porta Capena; every shopman drew water from this spring on the 15th of May

claims.statement: Archaeological evidence from Pompeii suggests that Mercury was among the most popular Roman gods.
claims.statement_id: Bukti arkeologi dari Pompeii menunjukkan Mercury termasuk dewa Romawi yang paling populer.
claims.quote: Archeological evidence from Pompeii suggests that Mercury was among the most popular of Roman gods.

claims.statement: Mercury features in Jack Kirby's first published comic book story, "Mercury in the 20th Century", in Red Raven Comics 1, 1940.
claims.statement_id: Mercury muncul dalam kisah komik pertama Jack Kirby yang diterbitkan, "Mercury in the 20th Century", di Red Raven Comics 1 tahun 1940.
claims.quote: Mercury features in the first published comic book story of Jack Kirby, Mercury in the 20th Century, published in Red Raven Comics 1, 1940.

claims.statement: Mercury's temple in Rome stood in the Circus Maximus, between the Aventine and Palatine Hills, and was built in 495 BC.
claims.statement_id: Kuil Mercury di Roma terletak di Circus Maximus, di antara Bukit Aventine dan Palatine, dan dibangun pada 495 SM.
claims.quote: Mercury's temple in Rome was situated in the Circus Maximus, between the Aventine and Palatine Hills, and was built in 495 BC.

claims.statement: Mercury became the god not only of the mercatores and the grain trade but of buying and selling in general; in streets with many shops, little chapels and images of the god appear to have been erected.
claims.statement_id: Mercury menjadi dewa bukan hanya para mercatores dan perdagangan gandum, tetapi jual beli pada umumnya; di jalan-jalan yang banyak tokonya tampaknya didirikan kapel kecil dan patung sang dewa.
claims.quote: Mercury became the god, not only of the mercatores and of the grain trade, but of buying and selling in general; and it appears that, at least in the streets where shops were common, little chapels and images of the god were erected.

claims.statement: The name Mercury is possibly related to the Latin words merx ("merchandise"), mercari (to trade) and merces (wages).
claims.statement_id: Nama Mercury mungkin berkaitan dengan kata Latin merx ("barang dagangan"), mercari (berdagang), dan merces (upah).
claims.quote: The name "Mercury" is possibly related to the Latin words merx ("merchandise"; cf. merchant, commerce, etc.), mercari (to trade), and merces (wages)

claims.statement: Like his Greek equivalent Hermes, he was given a magic wand by Apollo, which later became the caduceus, the staff with intertwined snakes.
claims.statement_id: Seperti padanannya Hermes, ia diberi tongkat sihir oleh Apollo yang kemudian menjadi caduceus, tongkat dengan ular yang berjalin.
claims.quote: Similar to his Greek equivalent Hermes, he was awarded a magic wand by Apollo, which later turned into the caduceus, the staff with intertwined snakes.

claims.statement: Ovid wrote that Mercury carried Morpheus's dreams from the valley of Somnus to sleeping humans.
claims.statement_id: Ovidius menulis bahwa Mercury membawa mimpi-mimpi Morpheus dari lembah Somnus kepada manusia yang tidur.
claims.quote: Additionally, Ovid wrote that Mercury carried Morpheus's dreams from the valley of Somnus to sleeping humans.

claims.statement: He is known to the Romans as Mercurius and occasionally in earlier writings as Merqurius, Mirqurios or Mircurios.
claims.statement_id: Bagi orang Romawi ia dikenal sebagai Mercurius, dan kadang dalam tulisan lebih awal sebagai Merqurius, Mirqurios, atau Mircurios.
claims.quote: is known to the Romans as Mercurius and occasionally in earlier writings as Merqurius, Mirqurios or Mircurios

claims.statement: Mercury was also considered a god of abundance and commercial success, particularly in Gaul, where he was said to be especially revered.
claims.statement_id: Mercury juga dipandang sebagai dewa kelimpahan dan keberhasilan dagang, terutama di Galia tempat ia konon sangat dihormati.
claims.quote: Mercury was also considered a god of abundance and commercial success, particularly in Gaul, where he was said to have been particularly revered.
